-- KPI 1: Facilities and Stores
WITH
  activity AS (
    -- Facility-scoped EMR writes in the last 30 days (the widest window used below)
    SELECT
      e.facility_id,
      e.created_by_id,
      e.created_date
    FROM
      emr_encounter e
    WHERE
      e.deleted = FALSE
      AND e.created_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      l.facility_id,
      md.created_by_id,
      md.created_date
    FROM
      emr_medicationdispense md
      JOIN emr_facilitylocation l ON l.id = md.location_id
    WHERE
      md.deleted = FALSE
      AND md.created_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      l.facility_id,
      d.created_by_id,
      d.created_date
    FROM
      emr_deliveryorder d
      JOIN emr_facilitylocation l ON l.id = d.destination_id
    WHERE
      d.deleted = FALSE
      AND d.created_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      l.facility_id,
      r.created_by_id,
      r.created_date
    FROM
      emr_requestorder r
      JOIN emr_facilitylocation l ON l.id = r.destination_id
    WHERE
      r.deleted = FALSE
      AND r.created_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  ),
  facility_activity AS (
    SELECT
      facility_id,
      COUNT(DISTINCT created_by_id) FILTER (
        WHERE
          created_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
      ) AS active_users
    FROM
      activity
    GROUP BY
      facility_id
  )
SELECT
  f.name AS "FACILITY_NAME",
  inst.eaushadhi_institute_name AS "INSTITUTE_NAME",
  sp.eaushadhi_warehouse_id AS "PARENT_ID",
  hf.hf_id AS "HOSPITAL_UNIQUE_ID",
  CASE
    WHEN fa.facility_id IS NULL THEN 'Inactive'
    ELSE 'Active'
  END AS "FACILITY_ACTIVE_STATUS",
  st.eaushadhi_store_id AS "STORE_ID",
  st.eaushadhi_store_name AS "STORE_NAME",
  CASE
    WHEN st.id IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN EXISTS (
      -- Indent raised
      SELECT
        1
      FROM
        care_dvdms_dvdmsoutwardrecordorder o
        JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsrecordorder ro ON ro.id = o.record_order_id
      WHERE
        ro.institute_store_id = st.id
        AND o.deleted = FALSE
        AND o.status = 'submitted'
        AND o.modified_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
    )
    OR EXISTS (
      -- Issue received; inward records with no outward_record can't be tied to a store
      SELECT
        1
      FROM
        care_dvdms_dvdmsinwardrecord i
        JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsoutwardrecordorder o ON o.id = i.outward_record_id
        JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsrecordorder ro ON ro.id = o.record_order_id
      WHERE
        ro.institute_store_id = st.id
        AND i.deleted = FALSE
        AND i.created_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
    ) THEN 'Active'
    ELSE 'Inactive'
  END AS "STORE_ACTIVE_STATUS",
  sp.eaushadhi_warehouse_name AS "PARENT_STORE_NAME",
  COALESCE(fa.active_users, 0) AS "ACTIVE_USERS_COUNT"
FROM
  facility_facility f
  LEFT JOIN abdm_healthfacility hf ON hf.facility_id = f.external_id
  AND hf.deleted = FALSE
  LEFT JOIN facility_activity fa ON fa.facility_id = f.id
  LEFT JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsinstitute inst ON inst.facility_id = f.id
  AND inst.deleted = FALSE
  -- One store / one supplier per institute is enforced in the UI, not in the
  -- database. LATERAL + LIMIT 1 keeps one row per facility, preferring the default.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      s2.id,
      s2.eaushadhi_store_id,
      s2.eaushadhi_store_name
    FROM
      care_dvdms_dvdmsstore s2
    WHERE
      s2.institute_id = inst.id
      AND s2.deleted = FALSE
    ORDER BY
      s2.is_default DESC,
      s2.id
    LIMIT
      1
  ) st ON TRUE
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      p2.eaushadhi_warehouse_id,
      p2.eaushadhi_warehouse_name
    FROM
      care_dvdms_dvdmssupplier p2
    WHERE
      p2.institute_id = inst.id
      AND p2.deleted = FALSE
    ORDER BY
      p2.is_default DESC,
      p2.id
    LIMIT
      1
  ) sp ON TRUE
WHERE
  f.deleted = FALSE
  AND f.is_active = TRUE
  AND f.is_public = TRUE [[AND st.eaushadhi_store_id = {{store_id}}]]
ORDER BY
  f.name;

-- KPI 2: Active DDCs
WITH
  dispenses AS (
    SELECT
      f.id AS facility_pk,
      st.id AS store_pk,
      st.eaushadhi_store_id,
      st.eaushadhi_store_name,
      md.created_by_id,
      COALESCE(md.when_handed_over, md.when_prepared, md.created_date)::DATE AS dispense_date
    FROM
      emr_medicationdispense md
      JOIN emr_facilitylocation l ON l.id = md.location_id
      JOIN facility_facility f ON f.id = l.facility_id
      AND f.deleted = FALSE
      AND f.is_active = TRUE
      AND f.is_public = TRUE
      JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsinstitute inst ON inst.facility_id = f.id
      AND inst.deleted = FALSE
      -- Dispenses happen at DDC counters, not at the store's own location, so
      -- each dispense is attributed to the institute's store (default first, as in KPI 1)
      JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
          s2.id,
          s2.eaushadhi_store_id,
          s2.eaushadhi_store_name
        FROM
          care_dvdms_dvdmsstore s2
        WHERE
          s2.institute_id = inst.id
          AND s2.deleted = FALSE
        ORDER BY
          s2.is_default DESC,
          s2.id
        LIMIT
          1
      ) st ON TRUE
    WHERE
      md.deleted = FALSE
      AND md.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'entered_in_error', 'stopped', 'declined')
      [[AND st.eaushadhi_store_id = {{store_id}}]]
      [[AND COALESCE(md.when_handed_over, md.when_prepared, md.created_date)::DATE = {{dispense_date}}]]
  ),
  active_users AS (
    -- Same rule as KPI 1: any EMR write in the last 7 days
    SELECT created_by_id FROM emr_encounter
    WHERE deleted = FALSE AND created_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
    UNION
    SELECT created_by_id FROM emr_medicationdispense
    WHERE deleted = FALSE AND created_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
    UNION
    SELECT created_by_id FROM emr_deliveryorder
    WHERE deleted = FALSE AND created_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
    UNION
    SELECT created_by_id FROM emr_requestorder
    WHERE deleted = FALSE AND created_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  ),
  ddc AS (
    -- A DDC is any location that has dispensed; no model flags dispensing locations
    SELECT
      l.facility_id,
      md.location_id,
      MAX(COALESCE(md.when_handed_over, md.when_prepared, md.created_date)) AS last_dispense
    FROM
      emr_medicationdispense md
      JOIN emr_facilitylocation l ON l.id = md.location_id
      AND l.deleted = FALSE
    WHERE
      md.deleted = FALSE
      AND md.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'entered_in_error', 'stopped', 'declined')
    GROUP BY
      l.facility_id,
      md.location_id
  ),
  ddc_counts AS (
    SELECT
      facility_id,
      COUNT(*) AS total_ddc_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE
          last_dispense >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
      ) AS active_ddc_count
    FROM
      ddc
    GROUP BY
      facility_id
  )
SELECT
  d.eaushadhi_store_id AS "STORE_ID",
  d.eaushadhi_store_name AS "STORE_NAME",
  u.username AS "USER_ID",
  -- Falls back to the username for accounts with no first/last name
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', u.first_name, u.last_name)), ''), u.username) AS "USER_NAME",
  CASE
    WHEN au.created_by_id IS NULL THEN 'Inactive'
    ELSE 'Active'
  END AS "USER_ACTIVE_STATUS",
  u.last_login AS "LATEST_LOGIN_DATE",
  d.dispense_date AS "DISPENSE_DATE",
  COUNT(*) AS "NUMBER_OF_DISPENSES",
  dc.total_ddc_count AS "TOTAL_DDC_COUNT",
  dc.active_ddc_count AS "ACTIVE_DDC_COUNT",
  dc.total_ddc_count - dc.active_ddc_count AS "INACTIVE_DDC_COUNT"
FROM
  dispenses d
  JOIN users_user u ON u.id = d.created_by_id
  LEFT JOIN active_users au ON au.created_by_id = u.id
  LEFT JOIN ddc_counts dc ON dc.facility_id = d.facility_pk
GROUP BY
  d.store_pk,
  d.eaushadhi_store_id,
  d.eaushadhi_store_name,
  u.id,
  au.created_by_id,
  d.dispense_date,
  dc.total_ddc_count,
  dc.active_ddc_count
ORDER BY
  "STORE_NAME",
  "DISPENSE_DATE" DESC,
  "USER_NAME";

-- KPI 3: Active DDC Issues (Patient Level)
WITH
  timing_units (code, days) AS (
    VALUES
      ('s', 1 / 86400.0),
      ('min', 1 / 1440.0),
      ('h', 1 / 24.0),
      ('d', 1.0),
      ('wk', 7.0),
      ('mo', 30.0),
      ('a', 365.0)
  ),
  stock_movements AS (
    -- Deliveries into a location
    SELECT
      o.destination_id AS location_id,
      pr.product_knowledge_id,
      sd.supplied_item_quantity AS quantity,
      sd.created_date AS moved_at,
      0 AS is_dispense,
      sd.id AS ref_id
    FROM
      emr_supplydelivery sd
      JOIN emr_deliveryorder o ON o.id = sd.order_id
      LEFT JOIN emr_inventoryitem sii ON sii.id = sd.supplied_inventory_item_id
      JOIN emr_product pr ON pr.id = COALESCE(sd.supplied_item_id, sii.product_id)
    WHERE
      sd.deleted = FALSE
      AND sd.status = 'completed'
    UNION ALL
    -- Deliveries out of a location
    SELECT
      o.origin_id,
      pr.product_knowledge_id,
      -sd.supplied_item_quantity,
      sd.created_date,
      0,
      sd.id
    FROM
      emr_supplydelivery sd
      JOIN emr_deliveryorder o ON o.id = sd.order_id
      LEFT JOIN emr_inventoryitem sii ON sii.id = sd.supplied_inventory_item_id
      JOIN emr_product pr ON pr.id = COALESCE(sd.supplied_item_id, sii.product_id)
    WHERE
      sd.deleted = FALSE
      AND sd.status = 'completed'
      AND o.origin_id IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    -- Dispenses from a location
    SELECT
      md.location_id,
      pr.product_knowledge_id,
      -md.quantity,
      COALESCE(md.when_handed_over, md.when_prepared, md.created_date),
      1,
      md.id
    FROM
      emr_medicationdispense md
      JOIN emr_inventoryitem ii ON ii.id = md.item_id
      JOIN emr_product pr ON pr.id = ii.product_id
    WHERE
      md.deleted = FALSE
      AND md.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'entered_in_error', 'stopped', 'declined')
  ),
  current_stock AS (
    SELECT
      ii.location_id,
      pr.product_knowledge_id,
      SUM(ii.net_content) AS quantity
    FROM
      emr_inventoryitem ii
      JOIN emr_product pr ON pr.id = ii.product_id
    WHERE
      ii.deleted = FALSE
    GROUP BY
      ii.location_id,
      pr.product_knowledge_id
  ),
  stock_ledger AS (
    -- Opening stock is not always recorded as a delivery, so instead of summing up from
    -- zero, start at today's stock and undo every movement after the row; on a dispense
    -- row that gives the stock just after that dispense
    SELECT
      m.ref_id AS dispense_id,
      m.is_dispense,
      COALESCE(cs.quantity, 0) - COALESCE(
        SUM(m.quantity) OVER (
          PARTITION BY
            m.location_id,
            m.product_knowledge_id
          ORDER BY
            m.moved_at,
            m.is_dispense,
            m.ref_id ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ),
        0
      ) AS stock_after
    FROM
      stock_movements m
      LEFT JOIN current_stock cs ON cs.location_id = m.location_id
      AND cs.product_knowledge_id = m.product_knowledge_id
  )
SELECT
  st.eaushadhi_store_id AS "STORE_ID",
  st.eaushadhi_store_name AS "STORE_NAME",
  dist.name AS "DISTRICT_NAME",
  mrp.meta ->> 'eaushadhi_prescription_id' AS "PRESCRIPTION_ID",
  COALESCE(mr.authored_on, mrp.created_date)::DATE AS "PRESCRIPTION_DATE",
  COALESCE(md.when_handed_over, md.when_prepared, md.created_date)::DATE AS "DISPENSE_DATE",
  uhid.value AS "PATIENT_UHID",
  ab.abha_number AS "ABHA_ID",
  drug.eaushadhi_drug_id AS "DRUG_ID",
  CONCAT_WS(' / ', drug.name, NULLIF(drug.brand_id, '')) AS "DRUG_NAME_BRAND_DETAILS",
  qp.quantity AS "QUANTITY_PRESCRIBED",
  sl.stock_after + md.quantity AS "AVAILABLE_STOCK_BEFORE_TRANSACTION",
  md.quantity AS "ACTUAL_QUANTITY_SENT_DISPENSED",
  sl.stock_after AS "UPDATED_INVENTORY_QUANTITY_AFTER_DISPENSE"
FROM
  emr_medicationdispense md
  JOIN emr_facilitylocation l ON l.id = md.location_id
  JOIN facility_facility f ON f.id = l.facility_id
  AND f.deleted = FALSE
  AND f.is_active = TRUE
  AND f.is_public = TRUE
  JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsinstitute inst ON inst.facility_id = f.id
  AND inst.deleted = FALSE
  -- Dispenses happen at DDC counters, so each one is attributed to the
  -- institute's store (default first), as in KPI 2
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      s2.eaushadhi_store_id,
      s2.eaushadhi_store_name
    FROM
      care_dvdms_dvdmsstore s2
    WHERE
      s2.institute_id = inst.id
      AND s2.deleted = FALSE
    ORDER BY
      s2.is_default DESC,
      s2.id
    LIMIT
      1
  ) st ON TRUE
  JOIN emr_inventoryitem ii ON ii.id = md.item_id
  JOIN emr_product pr ON pr.id = ii.product_id
  JOIN emr_patient p ON p.id = md.patient_id
  LEFT JOIN emr_medicationrequest mr ON mr.id = md.authorizing_request_id
  LEFT JOIN emr_medicationrequestprescription mrp ON mrp.id = mr.prescription_id
  LEFT JOIN abdm_abhanumber ab ON ab.patient_id = p.id
  AND ab.deleted = FALSE
  LEFT JOIN stock_ledger sl ON sl.dispense_id = md.id
  AND sl.is_dispense = 1
  -- District: the facility's geo organization or one of its parents
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      o.name
    FROM
      emr_organization o
    WHERE
      o.id = ANY (f.geo_organization_cache)
      AND o.org_type = 'govt'
      AND o.metadata ->> 'govt_org_type' = 'district'
      AND o.deleted = FALSE
    LIMIT
      1
  ) dist ON TRUE
  -- UHID: identifier whose config display is "UHID", as get_patient_uhid in care_radiology.
  -- Read from PatientIdentifier, which backs both Patient.instance_identifiers and
  -- Patient.facility_identifiers, so a UHID configured for the facility is found too
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      pi.value
    FROM
      emr_patientidentifier pi
      JOIN emr_patientidentifierconfig c ON c.id = pi.config_id
    WHERE
      pi.patient_id = p.id
      AND pi.deleted = FALSE
      AND pi.value <> ''
      AND LOWER(c.config ->> 'display') = 'uhid'
      AND (
        c.facility_id IS NULL
        OR c.facility_id = f.id
      )
    ORDER BY
      c.facility_id NULLS FIRST
    LIMIT
      1
  ) uhid ON TRUE
  -- Drug: the institute's mapping for the product, most used first (as _find_product_mapping)
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      pm.eaushadhi_drug_id,
      dr.name,
      dr.brand_id
    FROM
      care_dvdms_dvdmsproductmapping pm
      JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsdrug dr ON dr.id = pm.drug_id
    WHERE
      pm.institute_id = inst.id
      AND pm.product_knowledge_id = pr.product_knowledge_id
      AND pm.deleted = FALSE
    ORDER BY
      pm.usage_count DESC,
      pm.modified_date DESC
    LIMIT
      1
  ) drug ON TRUE
  -- Quantity prescribed: dose x frequency x (duration / period), summed over dosage instructions
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      SUM(
        (di -> 'dose_and_rate' -> 'dose_quantity' ->> 'value')::NUMERIC
        * (di -> 'timing' -> 'repeat' ->> 'frequency')::NUMERIC
        * (di -> 'timing' -> 'repeat' -> 'bounds_duration' ->> 'value')::NUMERIC * bu.days
        / NULLIF((di -> 'timing' -> 'repeat' ->> 'period')::NUMERIC * pu.days, 0)
      ) AS quantity
    FROM
      jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(mr.dosage_instruction, '[]'::JSONB)) di
      JOIN timing_units bu ON bu.code = di -> 'timing' -> 'repeat' -> 'bounds_duration' ->> 'unit'
      JOIN timing_units pu ON pu.code = di -> 'timing' -> 'repeat' ->> 'period_unit'
  ) qp ON TRUE
WHERE
  md.deleted = FALSE
  AND md.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'entered_in_error', 'stopped', 'declined')
  [[AND st.eaushadhi_store_id = {{store_id}}]]
  [[AND COALESCE(md.when_handed_over, md.when_prepared, md.created_date)::DATE = {{dispense_date}}]]
ORDER BY
  COALESCE(md.when_handed_over, md.when_prepared, md.created_date) DESC,
  md.id DESC;

-- KPI 4: Active DDC Issue Details (Patient and Drug Level)
WITH
  timing_units (code, days) AS (
    VALUES
      ('s', 1 / 86400.0),
      ('min', 1 / 1440.0),
      ('h', 1 / 24.0),
      ('d', 1.0),
      ('wk', 7.0),
      ('mo', 30.0),
      ('a', 365.0)
  ),
  stock_movements AS (
    -- Deliveries into a location
    SELECT
      o.destination_id AS location_id,
      pr.product_knowledge_id,
      sd.supplied_item_quantity AS quantity,
      sd.created_date AS moved_at,
      0 AS is_dispense,
      sd.id AS ref_id
    FROM
      emr_supplydelivery sd
      JOIN emr_deliveryorder o ON o.id = sd.order_id
      LEFT JOIN emr_inventoryitem sii ON sii.id = sd.supplied_inventory_item_id
      JOIN emr_product pr ON pr.id = COALESCE(sd.supplied_item_id, sii.product_id)
    WHERE
      sd.deleted = FALSE
      AND sd.status = 'completed'
    UNION ALL
    -- Deliveries out of a location
    SELECT
      o.origin_id,
      pr.product_knowledge_id,
      -sd.supplied_item_quantity,
      sd.created_date,
      0,
      sd.id
    FROM
      emr_supplydelivery sd
      JOIN emr_deliveryorder o ON o.id = sd.order_id
      LEFT JOIN emr_inventoryitem sii ON sii.id = sd.supplied_inventory_item_id
      JOIN emr_product pr ON pr.id = COALESCE(sd.supplied_item_id, sii.product_id)
    WHERE
      sd.deleted = FALSE
      AND sd.status = 'completed'
      AND o.origin_id IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    -- Dispenses from a location
    SELECT
      md.location_id,
      pr.product_knowledge_id,
      -md.quantity,
      COALESCE(md.when_handed_over, md.when_prepared, md.created_date),
      1,
      md.id
    FROM
      emr_medicationdispense md
      JOIN emr_inventoryitem ii ON ii.id = md.item_id
      JOIN emr_product pr ON pr.id = ii.product_id
    WHERE
      md.deleted = FALSE
      AND md.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'entered_in_error', 'stopped', 'declined')
  ),
  current_stock AS (
    SELECT
      ii.location_id,
      pr.product_knowledge_id,
      SUM(ii.net_content) AS quantity
    FROM
      emr_inventoryitem ii
      JOIN emr_product pr ON pr.id = ii.product_id
    WHERE
      ii.deleted = FALSE
    GROUP BY
      ii.location_id,
      pr.product_knowledge_id
  ),
  stock_ledger AS (
    -- Opening stock is not always recorded as a delivery, so instead of summing up from
    -- zero, start at today's stock and undo every movement after the row; on a dispense
    -- row that gives the stock just after that dispense
    SELECT
      m.ref_id AS dispense_id,
      m.is_dispense,
      COALESCE(cs.quantity, 0) - COALESCE(
        SUM(m.quantity) OVER (
          PARTITION BY
            m.location_id,
            m.product_knowledge_id
          ORDER BY
            m.moved_at,
            m.is_dispense,
            m.ref_id ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ),
        0
      ) AS stock_after
    FROM
      stock_movements m
      LEFT JOIN current_stock cs ON cs.location_id = m.location_id
      AND cs.product_knowledge_id = m.product_knowledge_id
  )
SELECT
  st.eaushadhi_store_id AS "STORE_ID",
  COALESCE(md.when_handed_over, md.when_prepared, md.created_date)::DATE AS "DISPENSE_DATE",
  uhid.value AS "PATIENT_UHID",
  ab.abha_number AS "ABHA_ID",
  drug.eaushadhi_drug_id AS "DRUG_ID",
  pk.name AS "PATIENT_WISE_DRUG_SENT",
  NULLIF(drug.brand_id, '') AS "DRUG_BRAND_DETAILS",
  -- Times this drug was sent to this patient, within the filtered rows
  COUNT(*) OVER (
    PARTITION BY
      md.patient_id,
      pr.product_knowledge_id
  ) AS "SENT_COUNT",
  sl.stock_after + md.quantity AS "STORES_AVAILABLE_STOCK",
  qp.quantity AS "QUANTITY_REQUESTED",
  md.quantity AS "QUANTITY_SENT",
  sl.stock_after AS "UPDATED_INVENTORY_QUANTITY"
FROM
  emr_medicationdispense md
  JOIN emr_facilitylocation l ON l.id = md.location_id
  JOIN facility_facility f ON f.id = l.facility_id
  AND f.deleted = FALSE
  AND f.is_active = TRUE
  AND f.is_public = TRUE
  JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsinstitute inst ON inst.facility_id = f.id
  AND inst.deleted = FALSE
  -- Dispenses happen at DDC counters, so each one is attributed to the
  -- institute's store (default first), as in KPI 2
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      s2.eaushadhi_store_id,
      s2.eaushadhi_store_name
    FROM
      care_dvdms_dvdmsstore s2
    WHERE
      s2.institute_id = inst.id
      AND s2.deleted = FALSE
    ORDER BY
      s2.is_default DESC,
      s2.id
    LIMIT
      1
  ) st ON TRUE
  JOIN emr_inventoryitem ii ON ii.id = md.item_id
  JOIN emr_product pr ON pr.id = ii.product_id
  JOIN emr_productknowledge pk ON pk.id = pr.product_knowledge_id
  JOIN emr_patient p ON p.id = md.patient_id
  LEFT JOIN emr_medicationrequest mr ON mr.id = md.authorizing_request_id
  LEFT JOIN abdm_abhanumber ab ON ab.patient_id = p.id
  AND ab.deleted = FALSE
  LEFT JOIN stock_ledger sl ON sl.dispense_id = md.id
  AND sl.is_dispense = 1
  -- UHID: identifier whose config display is "UHID", as get_patient_uhid in care_radiology.
  -- Read from PatientIdentifier, which backs both Patient.instance_identifiers and
  -- Patient.facility_identifiers, so a UHID configured for the facility is found too
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      pi.value
    FROM
      emr_patientidentifier pi
      JOIN emr_patientidentifierconfig c ON c.id = pi.config_id
    WHERE
      pi.patient_id = p.id
      AND pi.deleted = FALSE
      AND pi.value <> ''
      AND LOWER(c.config ->> 'display') = 'uhid'
      AND (
        c.facility_id IS NULL
        OR c.facility_id = f.id
      )
    ORDER BY
      c.facility_id NULLS FIRST
    LIMIT
      1
  ) uhid ON TRUE
  -- Drug: the institute's mapping for the product, most used first (as _find_product_mapping)
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      pm.eaushadhi_drug_id,
      dr.brand_id
    FROM
      care_dvdms_dvdmsproductmapping pm
      JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsdrug dr ON dr.id = pm.drug_id
    WHERE
      pm.institute_id = inst.id
      AND pm.product_knowledge_id = pr.product_knowledge_id
      AND pm.deleted = FALSE
    ORDER BY
      pm.usage_count DESC,
      pm.modified_date DESC
    LIMIT
      1
  ) drug ON TRUE
  -- Quantity requested: dose x frequency x (duration / period), summed over dosage instructions
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      SUM(
        (di -> 'dose_and_rate' -> 'dose_quantity' ->> 'value')::NUMERIC
        * (di -> 'timing' -> 'repeat' ->> 'frequency')::NUMERIC
        * (di -> 'timing' -> 'repeat' -> 'bounds_duration' ->> 'value')::NUMERIC * bu.days
        / NULLIF((di -> 'timing' -> 'repeat' ->> 'period')::NUMERIC * pu.days, 0)
      ) AS quantity
    FROM
      jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(mr.dosage_instruction, '[]'::JSONB)) di
      JOIN timing_units bu ON bu.code = di -> 'timing' -> 'repeat' -> 'bounds_duration' ->> 'unit'
      JOIN timing_units pu ON pu.code = di -> 'timing' -> 'repeat' ->> 'period_unit'
  ) qp ON TRUE
WHERE
  md.deleted = FALSE
  AND md.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'entered_in_error', 'stopped', 'declined')
  [[AND st.eaushadhi_store_id = {{store_id}}]]
  [[AND COALESCE(md.when_handed_over, md.when_prepared, md.created_date)::DATE = {{dispense_date}}]]
ORDER BY
  md.patient_id,
  pk.name,
  COALESCE(md.when_handed_over, md.when_prepared, md.created_date) DESC,
  md.id DESC;

-- KPI 5: Hospital Inventory Position (CARE System)
WITH
  location_stock AS (
    SELECT
      l.facility_id,
      ii.location_id,
      pr.product_knowledge_id,
      SUM(ii.net_content) AS quantity
    FROM
      emr_inventoryitem ii
      JOIN emr_product pr ON pr.id = ii.product_id
      JOIN emr_facilitylocation l ON l.id = ii.location_id
    WHERE
      ii.deleted = FALSE
    GROUP BY
      l.facility_id,
      ii.location_id,
      pr.product_knowledge_id
  )
SELECT
  st.eaushadhi_store_id AS "STORE_ID",
  st.eaushadhi_store_name AS "STORE_NAME",
  dist.name AS "DISTRICT_NAME",
  drug.eaushadhi_drug_id AS "DRUG_ITEM_ID",
  -- Products with no DVDMS mapping fall back to the CARE product name
  COALESCE(drug.name, pk.name) AS "DRUG_ITEM_NAME",
  COALESCE(
    SUM(ls.quantity) FILTER (
      WHERE
        ls.location_id = st.location_id
    ),
    0
  ) AS "AVAILABLE_MAIN_STORE_QTY",
  SUM(ls.quantity) AS "AVAILABLE_INHAND_QTY"
FROM
  facility_facility f
  JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsinstitute inst ON inst.facility_id = f.id
  AND inst.deleted = FALSE
  -- Main store: the institute's default store (first store if none is marked default)
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      s2.eaushadhi_store_id,
      s2.eaushadhi_store_name,
      s2.location_id
    FROM
      care_dvdms_dvdmsstore s2
    WHERE
      s2.institute_id = inst.id
      AND s2.deleted = FALSE
    ORDER BY
      s2.is_default DESC,
      s2.id
    LIMIT
      1
  ) st ON TRUE
  JOIN location_stock ls ON ls.facility_id = f.id
  JOIN emr_productknowledge pk ON pk.id = ls.product_knowledge_id
  -- Drug: the institute's mapping for the product, most used first (as _find_product_mapping)
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      pm.eaushadhi_drug_id,
      dr.name
    FROM
      care_dvdms_dvdmsproductmapping pm
      JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsdrug dr ON dr.id = pm.drug_id
    WHERE
      pm.institute_id = inst.id
      AND pm.product_knowledge_id = ls.product_knowledge_id
      AND pm.deleted = FALSE
    ORDER BY
      pm.usage_count DESC,
      pm.modified_date DESC
    LIMIT
      1
  ) drug ON TRUE
  -- District: the facility's geo organization or one of its parents
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      o.name
    FROM
      emr_organization o
    WHERE
      o.id = ANY (f.geo_organization_cache)
      AND o.org_type = 'govt'
      AND o.metadata ->> 'govt_org_type' = 'district'
      AND o.deleted = FALSE
    LIMIT
      1
  ) dist ON TRUE
WHERE
  f.deleted = FALSE
  AND f.is_active = TRUE
  AND f.is_public = TRUE [[AND st.eaushadhi_store_id = {{store_id}}]]
GROUP BY
  f.id,
  st.eaushadhi_store_id,
  st.eaushadhi_store_name,
  dist.name,
  pk.id,
  drug.eaushadhi_drug_id,
  drug.name
ORDER BY
  "STORE_NAME",
  "DRUG_ITEM_NAME";

card.name: Drug Receipt, Patient Dispensing and Available Inventory

stages.native:
-- KPI 6: Drug Receipt, Patient Dispensing and Available Inventory
WITH
  product_drug AS (
    -- Each CARE product's DVDMS drug for the institute, most used mapping first
    -- (as _find_product_mapping), so a product is counted under one drug only
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (pm.institute_id, pm.product_knowledge_id)
      pm.institute_id,
      pm.product_knowledge_id,
      pm.eaushadhi_drug_id,
      dr.name
    FROM
      care_dvdms_dvdmsproductmapping pm
      JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsdrug dr ON dr.id = pm.drug_id
    WHERE
      pm.deleted = FALSE
    ORDER BY
      pm.institute_id,
      pm.product_knowledge_id,
      pm.usage_count DESC,
      pm.modified_date DESC
  ),
  received AS (
    SELECT
      ir.institute_id,
      iir.drug_id AS eaushadhi_drug_id,
      MIN(iir.drug_name) AS drug_name,
      SUM(rid.quantity_accepted) AS quantity
    FROM
      care_dvdms_dvdmsrecorditemdelivery rid
      JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsrecorddelivery rd ON rd.id = rid.record_delivery_id
      AND rd.deleted = FALSE
      AND rd.status IN ('received', 'acknowledged', 'acknowledgement_failed')
      JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsinwarditemrecord iir ON iir.id = rid.inward_record_item_id
      AND iir.deleted = FALSE
      JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsinwardrecord ir ON ir.id = iir.inward_record_id
      AND ir.deleted = FALSE
    WHERE
      rid.deleted = FALSE
      AND rid.status <> 'REVERSED'
    GROUP BY
      ir.institute_id,
      iir.drug_id
  ),
  issued AS (
    SELECT
      pd.institute_id,
      pd.eaushadhi_drug_id,
      SUM(md.quantity) AS quantity
    FROM
      emr_medicationdispense md
      JOIN emr_facilitylocation l ON l.id = md.location_id
      JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsinstitute inst ON inst.facility_id = l.facility_id
      AND inst.deleted = FALSE
      JOIN emr_inventoryitem ii ON ii.id = md.item_id
      JOIN emr_product pr ON pr.id = ii.product_id
      JOIN product_drug pd ON pd.institute_id = inst.id
      AND pd.product_knowledge_id = pr.product_knowledge_id
    WHERE
      md.deleted = FALSE
      AND md.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'entered_in_error', 'stopped', 'declined')
    GROUP BY
      pd.institute_id,
      pd.eaushadhi_drug_id
  ),
  in_care AS (
    SELECT
      pd.institute_id,
      pd.eaushadhi_drug_id,
      SUM(ii.net_content) AS quantity
    FROM
      emr_inventoryitem ii
      JOIN emr_facilitylocation l ON l.id = ii.location_id
      JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsinstitute inst ON inst.facility_id = l.facility_id
      AND inst.deleted = FALSE
      JOIN emr_product pr ON pr.id = ii.product_id
      JOIN product_drug pd ON pd.institute_id = inst.id
      AND pd.product_knowledge_id = pr.product_knowledge_id
    WHERE
      ii.deleted = FALSE
    GROUP BY
      pd.institute_id,
      pd.eaushadhi_drug_id
  ),
  drugs AS (
    SELECT institute_id, eaushadhi_drug_id FROM received
    UNION
    SELECT institute_id, eaushadhi_drug_id FROM issued
    UNION
    SELECT institute_id, eaushadhi_drug_id FROM in_care
  )
SELECT
  st.eaushadhi_store_id AS "STORE_ID",
  st.eaushadhi_store_name AS "STORE_NAME",
  sp.eaushadhi_warehouse_id AS "PARENT_STORE_ID",
  sp.eaushadhi_warehouse_name AS "PARENT_STORE_NAME",
  d.eaushadhi_drug_id AS "DRUG_ID",
  COALESCE(pd.name, r.drug_name) AS "DRUG_NAME",
  COALESCE(r.quantity, 0) AS "QUANTITY_RECEIVED_FROM_DVDMS",
  COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) AS "QUANTITY_ISSUED_TO_PATIENTS",
  COALESCE(c.quantity, 0) AS "AVAILABLE_QUANTITY_IN_CARE"
FROM
  drugs d
  JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsinstitute inst ON inst.id = d.institute_id
  AND inst.deleted = FALSE
  JOIN facility_facility f ON f.id = inst.facility_id
  AND f.deleted = FALSE
  AND f.is_active = TRUE
  AND f.is_public = TRUE
  LEFT JOIN received r ON r.institute_id = d.institute_id
  AND r.eaushadhi_drug_id = d.eaushadhi_drug_id
  LEFT JOIN issued i ON i.institute_id = d.institute_id
  AND i.eaushadhi_drug_id = d.eaushadhi_drug_id
  LEFT JOIN in_care c ON c.institute_id = d.institute_id
  AND c.eaushadhi_drug_id = d.eaushadhi_drug_id
  -- At most one: a drug ID is mapped once per institute
  LEFT JOIN product_drug pd ON pd.institute_id = d.institute_id
  AND pd.eaushadhi_drug_id = d.eaushadhi_drug_id
  -- Default store and supplier, as in KPI 1
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      s2.eaushadhi_store_id,
      s2.eaushadhi_store_name
    FROM
      care_dvdms_dvdmsstore s2
    WHERE
      s2.institute_id = inst.id
      AND s2.deleted = FALSE
    ORDER BY
      s2.is_default DESC,
      s2.id
    LIMIT
      1
  ) st ON TRUE
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      p2.eaushadhi_warehouse_id,
      p2.eaushadhi_warehouse_name
    FROM
      care_dvdms_dvdmssupplier p2
    WHERE
      p2.institute_id = inst.id
      AND p2.deleted = FALSE
    ORDER BY
      p2.is_default DESC,
      p2.id
    LIMIT
      1
  ) sp ON TRUE
WHERE
  TRUE
  [[AND st.eaushadhi_store_id = {{store_id}}]]
ORDER BY
  "STORE_NAME",
  "DRUG_NAME";

-- KPI 7: Internal Transfers
WITH
  stock_movements AS (
    -- Deliveries into a location
    SELECT
      o.destination_id AS location_id,
      pr.product_knowledge_id,
      sd.supplied_item_quantity AS quantity,
      sd.created_date AS moved_at,
      'delivery_in' AS movement,
      sd.id AS ref_id
    FROM
      emr_supplydelivery sd
      JOIN emr_deliveryorder o ON o.id = sd.order_id
      LEFT JOIN emr_inventoryitem sii ON sii.id = sd.supplied_inventory_item_id
      JOIN emr_product pr ON pr.id = COALESCE(sd.supplied_item_id, sii.product_id)
    WHERE
      sd.deleted = FALSE
      AND sd.status = 'completed'
    UNION ALL
    -- Deliveries out of a location
    SELECT
      o.origin_id,
      pr.product_knowledge_id,
      -sd.supplied_item_quantity,
      sd.created_date,
      'delivery_out',
      sd.id
    FROM
      emr_supplydelivery sd
      JOIN emr_deliveryorder o ON o.id = sd.order_id
      LEFT JOIN emr_inventoryitem sii ON sii.id = sd.supplied_inventory_item_id
      JOIN emr_product pr ON pr.id = COALESCE(sd.supplied_item_id, sii.product_id)
    WHERE
      sd.deleted = FALSE
      AND sd.status = 'completed'
      AND o.origin_id IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    -- Dispenses from a location
    SELECT
      md.location_id,
      pr.product_knowledge_id,
      -md.quantity,
      COALESCE(md.when_handed_over, md.when_prepared, md.created_date),
      'dispense',
      md.id
    FROM
      emr_medicationdispense md
      JOIN emr_inventoryitem ii ON ii.id = md.item_id
      JOIN emr_product pr ON pr.id = ii.product_id
    WHERE
      md.deleted = FALSE
      AND md.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'entered_in_error', 'stopped', 'declined')
  ),
  current_stock AS (
    SELECT
      ii.location_id,
      pr.product_knowledge_id,
      SUM(ii.net_content) AS quantity
    FROM
      emr_inventoryitem ii
      JOIN emr_product pr ON pr.id = ii.product_id
    WHERE
      ii.deleted = FALSE
    GROUP BY
      ii.location_id,
      pr.product_knowledge_id
  ),
  stock_ledger AS (
    -- Opening stock is not always recorded as a delivery, so instead of summing up from
    -- zero, start at today's stock and undo every movement after the row; that gives
    -- the location's stock just after the row's movement
    SELECT
      m.ref_id,
      m.movement,
      COALESCE(cs.quantity, 0) - COALESCE(
        SUM(m.quantity) OVER (
          PARTITION BY
            m.location_id,
            m.product_knowledge_id
          ORDER BY
            m.moved_at,
            m.movement,
            m.ref_id ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ),
        0
      ) AS stock_after
    FROM
      stock_movements m
      LEFT JOIN current_stock cs ON cs.location_id = m.location_id
      AND cs.product_knowledge_id = m.product_knowledge_id
  )
SELECT
  st.eaushadhi_store_id AS "STORE_ID",
  sd.created_date::DATE AS "TRANSFER_DATE",
  fl.name AS "FROM_STORE",
  tl.name AS "TO_STORE",
  pk.name AS "PRODUCT",
  drug.name AS "DRUG_NAME",
  sd.supplied_item_quantity AS "QUANTITY",
  pr.batch ->> 'lot_number' AS "BATCH_NO",
  (pr.expiration_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::DATE AS "EXPIRY",
  drug.eaushadhi_drug_id AS "DRUG_ID",
  NULLIF(drug.brand_id, '') AS "DRUG_BRAND_ID",
  slo.stock_after + sd.supplied_item_quantity AS "FROM_STORE_INVENTORY_STOCK_COUNT_BEFORE_TRANSACTION",
  slo.stock_after AS "FROM_STORE_INVENTORY_STOCK_COUNT_AFTER_TRANSACTION",
  sli.stock_after - sd.supplied_item_quantity AS "TO_STORE_INVENTORY_STOCK_COUNT_BEFORE_TRANSACTION",
  sli.stock_after AS "TO_STORE_INVENTORY_STOCK_COUNT_AFTER_TRANSACTION"
FROM
  emr_supplydelivery sd
  JOIN emr_deliveryorder o ON o.id = sd.order_id
  AND o.deleted = FALSE
  JOIN emr_facilitylocation fl ON fl.id = o.origin_id
  -- A transfer: origin and destination both in the same facility
  JOIN emr_facilitylocation tl ON tl.id = o.destination_id
  AND tl.facility_id = fl.facility_id
  JOIN facility_facility f ON f.id = fl.facility_id
  AND f.deleted = FALSE
  AND f.is_active = TRUE
  AND f.is_public = TRUE
  JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsinstitute inst ON inst.facility_id = f.id
  AND inst.deleted = FALSE
  -- The facility's store (default first), as in KPI 1
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      s2.eaushadhi_store_id
    FROM
      care_dvdms_dvdmsstore s2
    WHERE
      s2.institute_id = inst.id
      AND s2.deleted = FALSE
    ORDER BY
      s2.is_default DESC,
      s2.id
    LIMIT
      1
  ) st ON TRUE
  LEFT JOIN emr_inventoryitem sii ON sii.id = sd.supplied_inventory_item_id
  JOIN emr_product pr ON pr.id = COALESCE(sd.supplied_item_id, sii.product_id)
  JOIN emr_productknowledge pk ON pk.id = pr.product_knowledge_id
  LEFT JOIN stock_ledger slo ON slo.ref_id = sd.id
  AND slo.movement = 'delivery_out'
  LEFT JOIN stock_ledger sli ON sli.ref_id = sd.id
  AND sli.movement = 'delivery_in'
  -- Drug: the institute's mapping for the product, most used first (as _find_product_mapping)
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      pm.eaushadhi_drug_id,
      dr.name,
      dr.brand_id
    FROM
      care_dvdms_dvdmsproductmapping pm
      JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsdrug dr ON dr.id = pm.drug_id
    WHERE
      pm.institute_id = inst.id
      AND pm.product_knowledge_id = pr.product_knowledge_id
      AND pm.deleted = FALSE
    ORDER BY
      pm.usage_count DESC,
      pm.modified_date DESC
    LIMIT
      1
  ) drug ON TRUE
WHERE
  sd.deleted = FALSE
  AND sd.status = 'completed'
  [[AND st.eaushadhi_store_id = {{store_id}}]]
  [[AND sd.created_date::DATE = {{transfer_date}}]]
  -- Matches either side of the transfer, as in the existing card
  [[AND {{location_name}} IN (fl.name, tl.name)]]
ORDER BY
  sd.created_date DESC,
  sd.id DESC;
